services.name: Fishing CHarters
services.desc: The fishing day generally starts at 8AM and lasts until 3 PM. If you want to go earlier, or later, no problem.There is also a half day charter available, from 8AM until noon."My tackle is always in good condition and my bait is frisky." I have plenty of rods and lures for your use. Bait and tackle is always included.

blurb: Guests go out on a well-equipped fishing boat guided by Captain John Evans to catch fish such as Perch, Northern Pike, Black Bass, Walleye, and Musky. After fishing for half a day, the guide takes guests to a private island for a cooked meal including the fish caught. The experience includes scenic views of the 1000 Islands area with historic castles and natural beauty.
extraNote: Captain Evans encourages catch and release but will clean and package boneless fish filets to take home · Behind Garlock's at 15 Washington Street Boathouse 12A Alexandria Bay, NY 13607
